render.scope: Twelve actual states on desktop/mobile; no injected status/effect/summon/packet. Snowball exit-speed timing and passenger hiding, eight independently rendered child walls, Torrent/Storm, SplitEarth warnings, returning axes and Waveform spell-versus-attack categories are checked.
